messages.subject_clean: setting environment to pick up data files in project dir
messages.body_plain:
Hello list.  I have just started using eclipse+StatET today in a linux environment.

Installation and setup has gone fairly smoothly, with most of the challenge coming from getting my head round eclipse.

One problem I have not been able to find a solution for is being able to load data files from the project directory.  I can do so if I explicitly set the whole path.  Eg
This works:  load('/home/user/dir1/dir2/project_dir/data_file.Rsave')
This does not: load('data_file.Rsave')

Outside of eclipse this works fine.  So it seems that the environment is not picking up the pwd, or '.', directory as being the first entry in the path.  This may be due to the project not being in the default workspace location.

Any ideas on how to set this right?

Many thanks,

Simon.

You can configure the initial working directory for R in the launch 
configuration of your R console in StatET.

You can set it to the complete path:
     /home/user/dir1/dir2/<project_dir>

Or specify it by using Eclipse variables, e.g. for a specific project:
     ${project_loc:<project_name>}

Regards,
Stephan

Hi Luís,

it seems you installed the rj package in the R library:

/usr/local/lib/R/site-library

But this library is not configured in your R environment in StatET:

R_LIBS=
R_LIBS_SITE=/usr/lib/R/site-library
R_LIBS_USER=


Adding the R library with the rj package to your R environment 
configuration in StatET should fix the issue.
Usually it is sufficient to use the button for automatic detection in 
the configuration dialog, but if it doesn't work, you have to add the 
library path manually.

Regards,
Stephan
